Grateful for the opportunity to share my perspective on AI and automation at the Agentic Automation in Finance Summit. It was energizing to be on stage with such sharp leaders from across Canada's financial sector. The conversation kept coming back to the questions that matter in production: 🔹 Reliability first: agents need SLIs, guardrails and clear failure modes, just like any other critical system. 🔹 Governance by design: in regulated industries, trust and auditability aren't optional. 🔹 Meas

Just wrapped an incredible few days at Splunk .conf26 in Denver. Thank you to everyone who showed up, asked sharp questions, and stuck around after to talk shop, that's the best part of these events. A deliberate choice on our part: this wasn't an AI session. It was about the unglamorous, load-bearing work of automation and observability that makes everything else possible.
